WELCOME HOME TO THE HEART OF SF CULTURE & CONVENIENCE
Step into luxury and style with this newly transformed, full-floor residence situated in one of San Francisco’s most vibrant and desirable corridors. Perfectly positioned on 16th Street between Dolores and Church, this high-end home places you steps from the best food, culture, and greenspace the city has to offer.
Whether you are stepping into a new chapter or upgrading your San Francisco lifestyle, this residence offers an elevated urban living experience.
RESIDENCE HIGHLIGHTS
Brand-New High-End Remodel: Experience the feel of a brand-new home with premium hardwood flooring, fresh architectural finishes, and pristine interiors throughout.
Gourmet Chef's Kitchen: Custom cabinetry, sleek quartz countertops, and a full suite of state-of-the-art, unused stainless steel appliances.
Spacious 3BR Layout: Generously sized bedrooms featuring modern lighting and built-in closet storage.
2 Full Designer Bathrooms: Elegantly tiled full baths with modern fixtures, glass enclosures, and spa-inspired finishes.
Bright & Airy Interiors: Expansive floor plan designed to optimize natural light and modern city living.
UNBEATABLE LOCATION & NEIGHBORHOOD
Dolores Park (3 Blocks Away): Enjoy sunny afternoons, breathtaking skyline views, and weekend picnics at SF’s iconic neighborhood hub.
Valencia Street Corridor (3 Blocks Away): World-class dining, artisanal coffee shops, boutique shopping, and vibrant nightlife right outside your door.
Transit & Commuter Friendly: Excellent access to Church St. MUNI lines, 16th St. BART, and tech shuttle stops for seamless transit anywhere in the Bay Area.
